title: 第1540章 天外天第1539章 杀仙
lines: “我将沟通天下九鼎神器之法，留于燧祖，日后可以传于天下万众。”
苏午打断了燧皇的话，他目光看向下方那道棺椁，棺椁之中，五色仙虹迸射而出，在此瞬投向天穹之上最后一道逐渐弥合的裂缝——
苏午的身影，亦汇同柳飞烟化作的五色仙虹，一齐投向天顶最后那道逐渐弥合的裂缝。
燧皇耳畔，不断响起苏午的叮嘱声：“‘仙’殒命于此，其所服食仙芝不死药气，而今尽皆侵染我身。
至此方天地之中，我已不能寻得解脱‘仙道杀劫’的解药。
真正的解药，应在天外——元河尽头之处。
我走之后，请托燧祖照看此天，小心提防三清的手段，以燧祖的能力，或许无法与三清分庭抗礼，但燧祖只需支撑一时——待到柳飞烟消化这番仙道气韵以后，便又是一位‘三不在’。
届时，我会设法将她送归此间天地，有她与您联手，当能与三清抗衡。
尤其是我而今‘仙道杀劫’临近，不论三清、大天都必生感应，他们少不了要在此中掺和一番，我可以自身多牵制它们一段时间，直至柳飞烟彻底消化仙道气韵，晋位‘三不在’之境。
燧祖，保重。
也请您为我带一句话给我的那些故旧，请他们亦多多保重。
我走了。”
苏午的声音还萦绕在燧皇的耳畔，他身形所化的五色仙虹，已然与柳飞烟所化虹光合汇一处，抵近了天顶那道好似只有头发丝一般细的裂缝——这个时候，燧皇终于忍耐不住，他心意震颤着，向天顶苏午所化的仙虹出声发问：“那你呢？！”
完人的天柱超脱相留在了这一重天地中。
代表故始人道源流的故始社稷大鼎，被其一分为十，其只掌握了其中一份，而将其余九鼎镇压于神州大地之上，为众生增添底力——如今，苏午身上还有寂灭死气不断蔓延，‘仙道杀劫’已经落在他的头顶！
他又该如何自处？
他提及了为天下人所做的种种准备，又何曾考虑过自身？
虽然燧皇先前与苏午数度交谈，已然隐隐感觉到了苏午最终的选择，但亲眼证见苏午的抉择之时，仍忍不住心神颤栗！
五色仙虹一刹那间隐没入那道发丝般的裂隙之中，瞬间隐遁无踪。
耸立于天地间、三首而六臂的三清，在这个刹那忽然崩散作万天星辰、山河草木——它化作一股浩风，同时漫入那道裂隙之内！
正如苏午所说，今时苏午‘仙道杀劫’当前，三清、大天却不可能不凑这个热闹！
天地之间，一片寂静。
一片寂静当中，‘大道’无声无息地运转着。
在‘三清’化为浩风消散的那个刹那，它留在天地间的真形轮廓熔炼作了三道人影——
一着天师道‘师君道袍’的老年道士，站在中间，名曰‘张鲁’；
一穿着鬼脸阴阳道袍，脸庞狭长，面色苍白如纸的中年道士，站在系师张鲁左侧，名曰‘张修’，实系原本五斗米道鬼师；
一穿着青色道袍，面貌形容与张鲁有几分相似，就是从前燧皇见过三清变化形容的天师道‘张盛’。
‘三张’看了立在原地的燧皇一眼，化为三股气息，刹那远飞而去！
——三清直以真形前去参与苏午的‘仙道杀劫’，但在此方世界当中，它亦留下了‘三张化相’，总领此天一半的权柄，以天师道与黄天道分庭抗礼，瓜分天下！
此时，天顶的裂缝完全弥合了。
而苏午留于燧皇的最后一道心识，在此时方才落入燧皇心间：“我未必会死，元河尽头那副棺椁之中，亦留有我之因果……
如若不能得生……
生，固我所欲，义，亦我所欲也。
二者不可兼得，舍生而取义者也……”
content_en:
"I will leave the method of communicating the Nine Cauldron Divine Artifacts in the world to Sui Ancestor, so that it can be passed on to everyone in the world in the future."
Su Wu interrupted Sui Huang's words, and he looked at the coffin below. From the coffin, a five-color fairy rainbow shot out, and at this moment, it shot towards the last gradually closing crack in the sky——
Su Wu's figure, together with the five-color fairy rainbow transformed by Liu Feiyan, were thrown towards the final crack in the zenith that was gradually closing.
Su Wu's warnings kept ringing in Emperor Sui's ears: "The 'immortal' died here, and the immortality of the immortal mushroom he took has now infected my body.
At this point in the world, I can no longer find the antidote to the 'immortal killing calamity'.
The real antidote should be found outside the sky - at the end of the Yuan River.
After I leave, please ask Sui Zu to take care of this day and be careful of the methods of the Sanqing. With Suizu's ability, he may not be able to compete with the Sanqing, but Suizu only needs to support it for a while - after Liu Feiyan digests the charm of this immortal way, he will be another 'Sanbui'.
At that time, I will try to send her back to this world. With her joining hands with you, we can compete with the Three Purities.
Especially now that I am approaching the "Immortal Killing Tribulation", both the Three Pure Ones and the Great Heaven will have to react, and they will inevitably have to get involved. I can restrain them for a while until Liu Feiyan completely digests the Immortal Spirit and reaches the realm of "Three Absences".
Suizu, take care.
Please also bring me a message for my old friends, asking them to take care of me too.
I'm leaving. "
Su Wu's voice still lingered in Sui Huang's ears. The five-color fairy rainbow transformed by his body had already merged with the rainbow light transformed by Liu Feiyan, and it was close to the crack in the zenith that seemed to be as thin as a hair. At this time, Sui Huang finally couldn't bear it anymore. His mind was trembling, and he asked the fairy rainbow transformed by Su Wu on the zenith: "What about you?!"
The transcendent phase of the Tianzhu of the perfect man remains in this heaven and earth.
The Gushi Sheji Great Cauldron, which represented the origin of the Gushi Humanity, was divided into ten parts by him. He only mastered one part of it, and suppressed the other nine cauldrons on the land of China to add strength to all living beings. Now, Su Wu still has the death aura spreading on his body, and the 'Immortal Killing Tribulation' has fallen on top of his head!
How should he deal with himself?
He mentioned all the preparations he had made for the people of the world, but how did he ever think about himself?
Although Emperor Sui had talked with Su Wu several times before and had a vague sense of Su Wu's final choice, he still couldn't help but tremble when he witnessed Su Wu's decision with his own eyes!
The five-color fairy rainbow disappeared into the hair-like crack in an instant and disappeared without a trace.
The Sanqing, which stood between heaven and earth with three heads and six arms, suddenly collapsed into thousands of stars, mountains, rivers, grass and trees in the sky at this moment - it turned into a mighty wind and spread into the crack at the same time!
Just as Su Wu said, now that Su Wu is facing the ‘Immortal Killing Tribulation’, it is impossible for Sanqing and Datian not to join in the fun!
There was silence between heaven and earth.
In the silence, the 'Great Road' moved silently.
At the moment when the 'Three Purities' turned into a mighty wind and dissipated, the outline of its true form left between heaven and earth was melted into three figures——
An elderly Taoist priest wearing the "Master Taoist Robe" of the Celestial Master's Way stood in the middle, named "Zhang Lu";
A middle-aged Taoist priest wearing a Yin-Yang Taoist robe with a ghost face, a long and narrow face, and a complexion as pale as paper, stood on the left side of the department master Zhang Lu. His name was "Zhang Xiu", and he was actually the original Five Pecks of Rice Taoist ghost master;
Wearing a blue Taoist robe, his appearance is somewhat similar to that of Zhang Lu. He is the Tianshi Taoist 'Zhang Sheng' whom Sui Emperor had seen change in the past.
'Three Zhangs' glanced at Sui Huang who was standing there, turned into three breaths, and flew away in an instant!
——San Qingzhi went to participate in Su Wu's "Immortal Killing Tribulation" in his true form, but in this world, he also left behind "three incarnations", taking over half of the power in this world, fighting against each other with Tianshi Dao and Huang Tiandao, and dividing the world!
At this time, the crack in the zenith was completely closed.
The last piece of Sui Huang's consciousness left by Su Wu fell into Sui Huang's heart at this moment: "I may not die, and the coffin at the end of the Yuan River also contains my cause and effect...
If you can't live...
Life is what I want, and righteousness is what I want.
You can't have both, you have to sacrifice your life for righteousness..."
title_en: Chapter 1540: Heaven and Earth Chapter 1539: Killing the Immortal
